tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: To Qualify for Award of This Contract, Bidder should have completed similar works during last 05 years i.e, 2021-22 To 2025-26,As A Prime Contractor, For At Least 80percent Of Similar Work Such as Supplying Of Electro Mechanical Machines or Electro Mechanical Equipment . Attach Work done certificate Issued by authority not Below the Rank of Executive Engineer.
Tenderer should be registered with the competent authority and should hold the valid Production/trading license.
The tenderer should upload an affidavit on stamp paper of Rs.100 stating that FIRM/COMPANY has not been blacklisted by any Central/State Government.
Tenderer should be the manufacturer OR authorized dealer for ISO / ISI goods and should hold the ISO/ISI renewed Registration Certificate in the name of the tenderer should be uploaded.
The bidder shall submit a detailed Supply plan for all Gram Panchayaths of said taluka of Kolar District. and Training Plan along with the technical bid of the use of the goods by the Purchaser.
Bidder should upload MSME Certificate registered in Karnataka State. Proof of this should be submitted
Goods and Service Tax Registration Certificate and Recent GSTR-3B From Should Be Attached.Tenderer should be uploaded the GST Registration Certificate.
Firm Name, Proprietor/Managing Director Name, Full Address and Official Mobile Number

Tenderer in its name should have in the last Five years, achieved in at least two financial years an annual minimum financial turnover of Amount Put To Tender. Audited statement and balance sheet certified by the ICAI registered auditor must be submitted for the relevant years.
